notes.title: The Beauty of Ammo Boxes
notes.notes:
[p]There is something really satisfying about collecting ammo in horror games.[/p][p][/p][p]Why is it so addicting to search around a level for that extra box of pistol rounds? Maybe it's because it feels like progress. You get a little bit stronger the more bullets you have - you are better prepared for your next enemy encounter.[/p][p][/p][p]With three unique weapons to choose from, collecting ammo became a core part of our game loop so we chose to make custom concept art for our ammo boxes.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/8913b3eeded14c75bc2d171c4d1e13ac7226d603.png"][/img]  [/p][p][b]Hand Cannon Ammo[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The hand cannon is a slow firing, high fire power weapon that you get later in the game. It can be used to break the shields of tank like enemies, do massive damage to weak points, or snipe at a shooter from a distance. Be careful though, this ammo is like gold - you don't want to run out of it because certain enemy encounters will be very difficult without the ability to break shields.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/5616982caf863945409d46e9ddd1dab81afa17fd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Pistol Ammo[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Pistol is your starter gun - though not the strongest weapon - it is great for almost all situations, specially if you improve it's firing speed and damage at the upgrade bench. With this gun - you'll almost always want to aim for head shots to stun enemies and do the maximum damage with your bullets - if you are shooting further away - be aware that there is a damage fall off on all weapons the further you are away from the target. Medium distance is recommended for the pistol.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/bb946029fea00d6d1ac43b91fa55ca10bfe0bd8c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]SMG Ammo[/b][/p][p][/p][p]You get the SMG early in the game during your first big enemy encounter at the Water Treatment plant. The SMG is harder to control than the other guns. It is great at short ranges or at controlling a horde of enemies. Sometimes you'll encounter a group of 3-4 Corpse Spawn (small spider like enemies) rushing toward you, and even with their low damage, the high rate of fire of the SMG gives you a good chance of hitting their stun points in a spray and pray moment. You might switch to your pistol to finish them off - but a few well placed shots with the SMG will also do the trick. There is a lot of ammo for the SMG placed around the game world - we expect you to shoot with it a lot. But don't get too trigger happy - after you upgrade the firing speed on this bad boy - it's easy to chew through your ammo in the blink of an eye.[/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Alter Evo[/b][/i] is coming to Steam December 1st. Please reach out to us via the [url="https://alterevogame.com"]alterevogame.com[/url] contact form if you are a Streamer / YoutTuber and would like a copy of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't seen the announcement trailer check it out again here: [/p][previewyoutube="QeUAVHgsTmY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Wishlist Alter Evo on our Steam page:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293640/Alter_Evo/"][/dynamiclink]-Technical Fiction[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Combat is 98% Done.
notes.notes:
[h1]We've spent the past month creating and implementing animations for the Henchmen.[/h1][p][/p][p]One play tester noted that our Henchmen felt too static, so we've focused on creating dynamic movements that show case the mechanical nature of their bodies and make them more reactive to gun fire.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Headshot Stagger Animation[/b]:[/p][p]Triggered when you shoot the Henchmen’s chin or visor. This long stagger buys you time to reload or escape.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/aba6591d760c82d0828108056baef41b3e34c6f4.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Punch Attack Animation[/b]:[/p][p]Triggered when a Henchman reaches you. Currently undodgeable, but that may change based on feedback. If you get hit, you’re stunned for half a second—your best bet is to run and retaliate.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/422869433f5f1d11b67c5563b1538ac7adfaf9bd.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]We also released a [b]new Combat Reel[/b] on our YouTube channel showcasing recent progress.[/h3][p][/p][previewyoutube="_fB1hWBseHI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b][u]Here's what you'll see in the video:[/u][/b][/h3][p][b]1. Henchmen punch attacks [/b][/p][p][b]2. Henchmen: 3 stagger animations (face, left, right) [/b][/p][p][b]3. Aim assist + aim glide improvements [/b][/p][p][b]4. Grapple vs. Corpse Spawn [/b][/p][p][b]5. Guided missile vs. THUG aircraft [/b][/p][p][b]6. Elite henchmen punch-out execution [/b][/p][p][b]7. Directional reaction hits (player) [/b][/p][p][b]8. Ranged henchmen evasion [/b][/p][p][b]9. 2 Corpse Spawn variations [/b][/p][p][b]10. Improved Corpse Shifter shield VFX[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293640/Alter_Evo/"][/dynamiclink][/h3][h3][u]What's left before we launch the game?[/u] [/h3][olist][*][p] Finalize ammo box art and pick up placement in each map[/p][/*][*][p] Place new enemy types in each level of the game[/p][/*][*][p] Add more combat sections to secondary areas.[/p][/*][*][p] Playtest, playtest, playtest.[/p][/*][*][p] Sound polish.[/p][/*][*][p] Cut scene improvements.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks for checking out our post! Wishlist Alter Evo and play the demo today![/p][p]
[b]-Technical Fiction[/b][/p]

notes.title: Progress on our Upgrade Bench + New Enemy Combat
notes.notes:
[p]After seeing how much people liked exploring the environments in our game - we realized that adding items around each level would be a perfect reward for the curious player. This is a popular mechanic in horror games, so we knew it would add value to our game loop.[/p][p][/p][p]In additional to lore notes and ammo, our latest item is the [b]Upgrade Node[/b], which players find when they search in hidden areas of each level.[/p][p][/p][p]You'll also be able to find Upgrade Benches around the game where you can spend your Upgrade Nodes to improve your guns. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/ea77ff629178b47ea28aa8ce0e8f53f1d7200a84.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In other news, we’ve added two new weapons alongside the pistol: an [b]SMG[/b] and a [b]Hand Cannon[/b] for dealing with heavily armored enemies.[/p][p]The [b]Corpse Shifter[/b] and [b]Henchmen[/b] are also getting overhauls—with new behaviors and animations to create more varied, horror-inspired combat and visually dynamic encounters.[/p][p]Wishlist Alter Evo now if you like upgrading guns and exploring mysterious levels👽[/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Big Demo Update Coming February 13th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you to everyone who has checked out the Alter Evo demo so far! We've noticed that many players are dropping off within the first 10 minutes, so we're making some changes to improve retention.

We are officially adding Gun Combat to improve the fun and play-ability of enemy sections.

We are making game flow and narrative improvements across the board.

All of these changes will be released on February 13th.

We will leave the demo up in it's current form until then.

Thanks again for your support.

Technical Fiction

notes.title: The New Alter Evo Demo is Ready to Play
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43552839/66c77a5563a439206f83de5959f12adc6fdb0171.gif[/img]

We are excited to announce the new Alter Evo Demo 2025 is ready to play! 

We've been hard at work this week collecting feedback and improving the demo. We can't wait for you to check it out!

What's the new demo like? 

Step into the strange, futuristic city of North Terrace where danger lurks at every turn. In this gripping 30-minute demo, Evo finds himself at a breaking point. His unhinged landlord demands he pay his overdue rent or face dire consequences. Can a job interview at a seedy tech startup turn his luck around, or does his therapist hold the key to his survival? 

Meanwhile, the city of North Terrace is under siege by a surge of terrifying Negative Agents. 

Will Evo find a way out, or will the city consume him?

What You’ll Do in the Demo:

Drive Through the Wasteland: Navigate the eerie, bullet-scarred streets of North Terrace in your hover truck.

Wander Mysterious Spaces: Explore Evo’s unsettling apartment, where every detail hints at a deeper mystery.

Interact with Characters: Meet your therapist Dr. Cid, AJ the goth, her boss the CEO, and many more.

Face Danger in the Dark: Confront shadowy enemies in a tense nighttime encounter at the water treatment plant.

Please leave a review on the demo page after you complete the demo. We need your feedback to make Alter Evo the best it can be!

[previewyoutube=naoxtTlipPs;full][/previewyoutube]

-Technical Fiction
